analysis: The only change in this batch is a documentation addition to docs/developer/test.md (head lines ~2465-2485, a new subsection on cluster service listeners after pairing again). The two supplied units are base_text excerpts (lines 1843-2535) that do not include the added lines; I relied on the patch excerpt for the new content. The addition describes tests (ClusterServicePairingChangeTests, ClusterConsoleChecks) that verify old listeners reject a new pairing (handshakeRejected), removed pairings stop both listeners, and an unreadable pairing store keeps the same listeners. It states loopback ports are used, with no production port or Thunderbolt interface. No source code, keys, authorization paths, attestation, encryption or cache behavior changes, so no threat-model assets (A-001..A-019) or boundaries (TB-002/003/007/011/012/013) are altered. The surrounding base text covers prefix-cache tests, which bear on T-041 (tenant partition and SSD records), but these lines are unchanged. Remaining question: the actual pairing-change behavior in the ClusterService implementation and the tests themselves are not in the supplied evidence, so I cannot confirm that the code matches the described behavior. This is a documentation-only change with no security regression identified here. The cluster pairing and peer-link listener boundary is not clearly modeled in the supplied threat-model index, so a future code-bearing PR touching ClusterService may need a threat-model entry.
